body:
Founder: 'update the parena readme with the good bits that are actually true.' Verified and added: the real parena ci-status subcommand (exit codes 0/1/2/3 confirmed against stdlib/ci/status.prn directly), its honest narrow FFI-to-curl scope, and the real two-stage bootstrap build (Makefile). Deliberately excluded an external AI's broader unverified 'replacing Python' framing -- no such initiative exists in this repo. Commit e940d58.

⚓ ☃
title: README documents the real ci-status/bootstrap dogfooding story
